FROM (
    SELECT 
        dws_sales_category_daily.category_id AS 商品品类ID,
        SUM(dws_sales_category_daily.gmv) AS 商品成交总额,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(dws_sales_category_daily.gmv) DESC, dws_sales_category_daily.category_id ASC) AS rn

) AS t
WHERE t.rn <= 5
ORDER BY t.rn

cases.question: 支付明细记录数最多的3种付款方式是什么
cases.generated_sql:
WITH payment_counts AS (
  SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM fact_payment
  GROUP BY payment_type
)
SELECT payment_type AS 付款方式, cnt AS 支付明细记录数
FROM (
  SELECT payment_type, cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC, payment_type ASC) AS rn
  FROM payment_counts
) t
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY rn
cases.validated_sql: WITH payment_counts AS (SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fact_payment GROUP BY payment_type) SELECT payment_type AS 付款方式, cnt AS 支付明细记录数 FROM (SELECT payment_type, cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC, payment_type ASC) AS rn FROM payment_counts) AS t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY rn LIMIT 500

       SUM(purchase_date BETWEEN '2018-04-01' AND '2018-04-30') AS 四月订单数量,

  AND purchase_date BETWEEN '2018-04-01' AND '2018-05-31'
